name: m365-copilot2api-on-cloudflare-worker
description: M365 Copilot ChatHub -> OpenAI-compatible API gateway on Cloudflare Workers (port of M365-Copilot2API)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:i18n && wrangler deploy --dry-run

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional bootstrap administrator password. Leave empty to use the built-in default (`admin123`) and set a new password on first login. You can change it later in the console regardless of this value.

m365-copilot2api_KV.description: Single KV namespace storing accounts, API keys, sessions, settings and usage stats. A new namespace is provisioned automatically.
